Re-read visually at full size: every digit is clear, so the 17,115.63 gap is not a misread. The printed total matches the page's own later lines (2,697,186.50 - 1,538,364.06 = 1,158,822.44 printed; 468,845.16 + 1,158,822.44 - 1,291,970.30 = 335,697.30 printed), and the 2024 column adds up exactly. So the 2025 revenue lines as printed are short by 17,115.63, the same as Grant Revenue on p6. Recording it as printed is correct. But the governmental roll-forward in the JSON also misses by the same amount (468,845.16 + 2,680,070.87 - 8,667,934.36 + 5,837,600.00 = 318,581.67 vs ending 335,697.30), and no 'reconcile' entry records that.
